reference.notes:
The resolver from the spec is in place and the server now uses it. All 376 tests in the package pass with 0 failures. That count includes the new test file, the hidden test folder and the existing tests.

**`apps/api/src/image-digest.ts`**: `resolveImageDigest(env = process.env)`:
- It reads `env.ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4` once, before any `await`. If the value is missing or `""`, it returns `undefined` and makes no request. It reads no other key, including `IMAGE_DIGEST`, and keeps no cache.
- Otherwise it makes one `GET` request with the global `fetch` to exactly that URI, using `AbortSignal.timeout(1000)`. The time limit also covers reading the response body.
- It keeps the part of `ImageID` after the last `@` and returns it only if it matches `/^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$/`. The value is not trimmed or lowercased first.
- Every failure (refused connection, bad URI, non-2xx status, timeout, body that isn't JSON, `ImageID` missing or not a string, invalid digest) is caught and gives `undefined`. It never throws or rejects.
- The timeout and the pattern are private constants; `resolveImageDigest` is the only export.

**`apps/api/src/server.ts`**: the build record is now `{ ...buildInfo(env), imageDigest: await resolveImageDigest() }`, worked out with a top-level `await` before `serve()` is called. When the digest is `undefined`, `imageDigest` is left out of the `GET /version` JSON. I did not change `createApp`, `env.ts` or the shared `BuildInfoDto` and its schema.
